title: The Weapons That Bowed to Rama | Ramayana Ep 6
edition: vulgate (southern recension), sa.wikisource; verse numbers cross-checked on valmikiramayan.net

scenes.narration: Rama's new weapons bowed before him.
scenes.visual: {rama_teen} with his back to the viewer, standing small in the foreground of a forest clearing at dawn, before him a semicircle of tall slender human-shaped figures made entirely of soft glowing golden chalk light, exactly two arms each, smooth glowing featureless faces, bare heads, simple dhoti wraps drawn in light, bare shoulders, each figure marked by its own weapon emblem glowing at its chest, heads bowed and palms joined at the chest in namaste, above them glowing Indian astra weapons floating in the air: a spinning golden discus with a serrated rim, a long arrow of light, a slender spear of light and a golden vajra thunderbolt with curved prongs at both ends, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: The morning after Tataka, Vishvamitra smiled. Take all my weapons, he told Rama.
scenes.visual: at sunrise in a quiet ancient Indian forest clearing, {vishvamitra} smiling warmly and raising one open hand as he speaks, facing {rama_teen} with his back to the viewer and {lakshmana_teen} standing side by side, soft morning rays slanting through tall sal trees, birds on the branches, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: The discus of Dharma. The discus of Time. The Vajra thunderbolt.
scenes.visual: three glowing Indian astra weapons drawn as medium-sized chalk emblems stacked down the middle and lower half of a plain dark chalkboard, the whole top third of the board left completely empty dark chalkboard: at the top a bright golden spinning war discus with a serrated flaming rim radiating light, in the middle a dark iron discus ringed with tiny stars and moon phases around its rim, at the bottom a golden vajra thunderbolt with five curved prongs at each end and a round grip in the middle, crackling with lightning, symbolic emblems floating in empty space, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: The Brahma weapon. Weapons of fire, of wind, even of sleep.
scenes.visual: four glowing Indian astra emblems standing upright side by side in one horizontal row across the middle of a plain dark chalkboard, all pointing upward, evenly spaced and not touching: an arrow of pure white light rising from a radiant lotus, an arrow wreathed in saffron flames, an arrow trailing swirling spirals of wind, an arrow wrapped in drifting curls of soft silver sleepy mist, symbolic emblems floating in empty space, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: Facing east, the sage gave him their mantras, rare even for gods.
scenes.visual: {vishvamitra} standing tall on a riverbank facing the rising sun on the eastern horizon, both palms raised as he chants, a small sacred fire burning on a square brick altar beside him, flowing ribbons of glowing chalk light rising from the fire and curling through the air toward {rama_teen} with his back to the viewer, standing a little behind the sage, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: As he chanted, the weapons stood before Rama, palms joined. We serve you, they said.
scenes.visual: a row of tall slender human-shaped figures made entirely of soft glowing golden chalk light, exactly two arms each, smooth glowing featureless faces, bare heads, simple dhoti wraps drawn in light, bare shoulders, each figure marked by its own weapon emblem glowing at its chest stepping out of a bright glow and standing before {rama_teen} with his back to the viewer, each figure with palms joined at the chest in namaste, each with its weapon shape glowing softly at its feet: a discus, an arrow, a spear, a mace, a vajra thunderbolt, warm radiant light filling the forest clearing, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: Rama touched them and said: dwell in my mind.
scenes.visual: close-up drawn only in white and gold chalk outlines on the black board, a young prince's simple slender right hand with five fingers and a simple gold bangle at the wrist, reaching in from the left and gently touching the two joined glowing hands of a figure made of soft golden chalk light whose palms are pressed together in greeting, both hands of the light figure clearly visible, streams of light flowing from the figure up along the prince's forearm, sparks of light drifting upward, the hand and the glowing palms centred on a plain dark chalkboard, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: Now not even gods can overcome me, Rama said. But teach me how to call them back.
So the sage taught him the recall. Those powers bowed too, like embers, smoke, sun and moon.
scenes.visual: a second row of human-shaped figures of light appearing before {rama_teen} standing small in the foreground with his back to the viewer, his dhoti drawn in simple loose folds, the dark sky above him plain and empty, all bowing deeply with palms joined at the chest, exactly two arms each, smooth glowing featureless faces, bare heads, simple dhoti wraps drawn in light: one figure glowing red-orange like smouldering embers, one made of drifting grey smoke, one blazing gold like the sun, one cool silver-white like the full moon, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: Go now, Rama told them. Come to my mind when I need you.
scenes.visual: seen from high above, {rama_teen} standing alone at the centre of a round forest clearing, a ring of small glowing human-shaped figures of light walking in a circle around him, their trails of light forming a luminous spiral that rises and fades into the dark sky, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

scenes.narration: Ahead lay Siddhashrama. Here, said the sage, the rakshasas come. Here you must strike them.
scenes.tts: Ahead lay Siddhaashrama. Here, said the sage, the raakshasas come. Here you must strike them.
scenes.visual: {rama_teen} with his back to the viewer, standing small in the foreground on a forest path at dusk, beside him {vishvamitra} with dark hair streaked with grey tied in a topknot, a dark beard and a red tilak on his forehead, pointing ahead with his staff, in the distance a humble ancient Indian forest hermitage of thatched huts with a brick fire altar and a thin line of smoke on the edge of a hill, far on the horizon a few small dark human-shaped shadow figures with wild hair standing among the trees, exactly two arms each, bare-headed, vertical composition, subject in the center of the frame, open dark chalkboard space at the top, lower quarter of the frame plain dark chalkboard

sources.note: next morning Vishvamitra smiles and says he is pleased; gives Rama all the weapons
discus of danda, dharma, kala, Vishnu, Indra; vajra; Brahma weapon (brahmastra 1.27.7)
facing east, the sage gives the mantras; weapons hard to obtain even for gods
as he chants, the weapons stand before Rama, palms joined: 'we are your servants'
Rama touches them with his hand: 'be present in my mind'
on-screen verse: 'I have the weapons, unassailable even by gods; I wish for their withdrawals (samhara)'
the sage teaches the withdrawals; they appear bowing, like embers, smoke, sun and moon
'go as you wish; in my mind, help me when needed'; they circle him and depart
Siddhashrama; teaser verse 1.29.23: rakshasas come to this hermitage, here you must kill them
Maricha and Subahu attack the sacrifice (named on the Next card only)
